sentences.text:
Pushpendra Singh S/O Shri Nawab Singh vs State Of Rajasthan
on 16 June, 2023
Author: Praveer Bhatnagar
Bench: Praveer Bhatnagar
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
 S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 6811/2023
Pushpendra Singh S/o Shri Nawab Singh, Aged About 31 Years,
R/o Nagla Chaudhary, Santruk Police Station Udyog Nagar
District Bharatpur.

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Bench At Jaipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
At Present In Central Jail, Bharatpur.
 ----Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Rajasthan, Through The Pp
 ----Respondent
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Harendra Singh
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Laxman Meena, Pp
 Mr. Ajay Singh for Complainant
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Praveer Bhatnagar ( V. J. ) Order 16/06/2023
1.
The instant bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. on behalf of accused-petitioner Pushpendra Singh.

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.71/2018 dated 31.03.2018 registered at Police Station Udyog Nagar, District Bharatpur for the offence(s) under Sections 323, 341, 326, 307, 498A and 34 IPC.
2. Learned counsel for the accused-petitioner submits that all the material witnesses examined by learned trail court have been declared hostile and not supported the prosecution story.
The petitioner is in judicial custody since long and the trial of the case will take considerable time.

Thus,
the bail application of the petitioner may be allowed.
3. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor and the learned counsel for the complainant vehemently opposes the bail application and (2 of 2) [CRLMB-6811/2023

entities.text: Nawab Singh vs State Of Rajasthan
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and also looking to the fact that all the material witnesses have declared hostile and not supported the prosecution story, I deem it just and proper to enlarge the accused-petitioner on bail.

5. Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner Pushpendra Singh S/o Shri Nawab Singh shall be enlarged on bail in connection with FIR No.71/2018 dated 31.03.2018 registered at Police Station Udyog Nagar, District Bharatpur provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/-
each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
(PRAVEER BHATNAGAR ( V. J. )),J Mohit/715 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
